direction.description: Modern luxe dark UI fusing Islamic manuscript illumination (girih geometry, medallions, gold illumination) with contemporary glassmorphism + aurora effects, physics-feel motion, and scroll reveal choreography.
styles: Aurora UI (drifting radial beams in gold/verdant)
effects: noise grain overlay (SVG turbulence, blend overlay)
decisions: Kept all existing brand tokens; no new hues introduced.
Glassmorphism adapted to gold-tinted ink (not white).
Manuscript ornaments (girih/medallions) preserved as sparse, atmospheric layer under modern surface treatments.
RTL-aware: CTA arrows flip with rtl:; Arabic uses Amiri.
Performance: backdrop-blur scoped to surfaces only; background motion is transform/opacity composited; reduced-motion globally respected.
